key_highlights: ASX suffered a severe $169B weekly wipeout as recession fears and labor market contraction rattled equities.
Unemployment jumped to a five-year peak, validating concerns that the RBA's rate-hiking cycle has peaked and begun to damage the real economy.
Australian housing market downturn accelerated sharply with Sydney property prices falling at near-historic rates.
Retail distress deepened significantly, highlighted by 1,700 redundancies at David Jones amid intensifying competition from Myer.
Precious metals and critical minerals exploration bucked market weakness with active capital raisings and project restarts.

sectors.trend: Small-cap gold developers and critical minerals explorers maintain strong capital raising momentum despite broader index drawdown.
sectors.implications: Capital rotation into gold producers (e.g., NST.AX, EVN.AX) provides defensive safe-haven exposure and AUD depreciation protection.

sectors.trend: Aggressive cumulative rate increases have exhausted borrowing capacity, while corporate governance scrutiny increases around major lenders.
sectors.implications: Major banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX) face net interest margin pressure, slowing credit growth, and rising loan provisioning risk.

sectors.trend: Severe real income contraction and high debt servicing are triggering aggressive retail workforce downsizing and department store restructuring.
sectors.implications: Elevated downside risk for high-cost retail operators; structural market share shift toward value-focused competitors (e.g., MYR.AX, WES.AX).

sectors.trend: Residential price declines are steepening rapidly across major metropolitan markets following aggressive policy tightening.
sectors.implications: Downward asset revaluations for residential property developers and REITs; heightened balance sheet caution required for leveraged property trusts.

sectors.trend: East coast domestic gas pricing pressures remain elevated amidst debates over major capital project viability.
sectors.implications: Margin tailwinds for wholesale gas suppliers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) contrast with rising operating cost headwinds across industrial manufacturing.

key_themes: Labor market deterioration pushing unemployment to a five-year high, bringing forward expectations of RBA monetary easing.
Macroeconomic stress driving a $169B broad-based sell-off across the benchmark ^AXJO index.
Housing market liquidity shock and wealth contraction impacting household consumption and bank lending books.
Contrarian resilience and capital demand within gold and critical minerals exploration.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Increase cash weighting and rotate equity holdings into defensive, non-cyclical sectors such as healthcare (CSL.AX).

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mortgage Credit Stress and Housing Deflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic banking exposure and REITs heavily exposed to leveraged residential development.
Favor ASX offshore earners with US dollar revenue streams to capture foreign exchange translation benefits.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Major Bank Compliance and Governance Exposure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Cap single-name exposure to NAB.AX until remediation and advisory conflict reviews conclude.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight ASX Gold and Critical Minerals Producers
opportunities.rationale: Strong domestic gold restart pipeline and capital raising appetite provide counter-cyclical upside and currency devaluation protection.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Rotation into Global Healthcare Earners
opportunities.rationale: High proportion of foreign currency revenue protects earnings against domestic consumer contraction and AUD depreciation.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Long on Retail Consolidation Beneficiaries
opportunities.rationale: Myer positioned to capture displaced market share, concessions, and customer traffic following David Jones' downsizing.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Core Equities Portfolio via Benchmark Put Protection
defensive_moves.rationale: Rapid liquidation of $169B from the market and rising unemployment justify downside hedging on the broad market.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Allocation to Major Mortgage Lenders
defensive_moves.rationale: Severe housing price declines and reaching the end of the RBA rate hike cycle compress banking net interest margins and heighten bad debt risks.
Subdued real wage growth, rising unemployment, and declining household wealth pose elevated headwinds for non-essential retail spending.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias over 1–3 months as the ASX processes the $169B drawdown, deteriorating employment figures, and persistent property downturn pressures.
market_outlook.long_term: Stabilisation likely over 6–12 months as the RBA officially pauses or begins easing monetary policy to cushion economic activity.
key_catalysts: Official RBA Cash Rate decision and post-meeting monetary statement
Quarterly Australian CPI and wage price index data releases
Monthly ABS labor force report and underemployment statistics
CoreLogic national home value indices and mortgage delinquency rates
Domestic wholesale gas policy updates and energy market regulator findings
watch_list: AUD/USD exchange rate behavior near cyclical support zones
Non-performing loan (NPL) progression across Big Four balance sheets
Small-cap gold capital raising pricing and exploration restart timelines
Consumer confidence and retail turnover indices
Iron ore benchmarks and Chinese stimulus announcements
